title: Editing rules per source file and bundle version
description: The top-level rule set serves released bundle versions 1–4. bundleRules holds a complete rule set for a pending bundle version: the key is the bundle version, while version is the editing-rules format.

bundleRules.description: Rules selected by the bundle version the Editor loads. A listed version uses its own rules; other versions use the top-level rules.

localPlaceSource.description: The source property of a place created in the editor.

landmarkLevel.description: A level only places in landmarkCategory may have.

ignoredCharactersPattern.description: Removed, with case folding, before comparing a value with forbiddenValues.

type.description: Text when absent. directions is the ordered stop list of a route; entrances are the located entrances of a label, which follow the walls of their building; list is an array of texts; a position is a WGS84 longitude/latitude pair and positions is a line of them; an identifier is an OSM number or the local ID of an object added in the editor, and identifiers are a list of them.

allowsNull.description: A missing fact is recorded as null.

reference.description: The named file holds the object whose entity ID is the value.

addOnly.description: Only a new object states it; afterwards it is identity and stays locked.

limitedKinds.description: What a kind the pipeline derives, or that only frames the map, allows instead of the file's rules.

derivedGeometry.description: The editor computes this geometry from an edit of another object, such as a shared border; only its structure is checked.

requiredAny.description: A feature needs at least one of these properties.
